{"python":"# Let's check the standard Palmer Penguins dataset values for male bill depth
# In Palmer penguins:
# Adelie male bill depth is around 19.07
# Chinstrap male bill depth is around 19.25
# Gentoo male bill depth is around 15.72
# Overall male bill depth in palmerpenguins is around 17.89 mm!
# Wait, 19.68 is much higher than typical average bill depth for all males (which includes Gentoo ~15.7).
# In palmerpenguins: Adelie: 73 males, Gentoo: 61 males, Chinstrap: 34 males.
# Total males ~ 168. Mean bill depth cannot be 19.68!
print(19.68)
"}
